contents_shape.name: contents_shape
contents_shape.value:
("contents"."kind" = 'question' AND "contents"."title" IS NOT NULL AND "contents"."question_id" IS NULL AND "contents"."target_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("contents"."kind" = 'answer' AND "contents"."title" IS NULL AND "contents"."question_id" IS NOT NULL AND "contents"."target_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("contents"."kind" = 'comment' AND "contents"."title" IS NULL AND "contents"."question_id" IS NULL AND "contents"."target_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "contents"."target_id" IS NOT NULL)

contents_question_fields.name: contents_question_fields
contents_question_fields.value: "contents"."kind" = 'question' OR ("contents"."accepted_answer_id" IS NULL AND "contents"."file_version_id" IS NULL AND "contents"."award_cents" = 0)

contents_acceptance.name: contents_acceptance
contents_acceptance.value:
("contents"."accepted_answer_id" IS NULL AND "contents"."accepted_by" IS NULL AND "contents"."acceptance_id" IS NULL AND "contents"."award_cents" = 0)
        OR ("contents"."accepted_answer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "contents"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "contents"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "contents"."accepted_term_id" IS NOT NULL AND "contents"."acceptance_id" IS NOT NULL)
